national_news.title: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth Conferred Honorary Rank of General of Nepali Army
bullets: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth was conferred the honorary rank of General of the Nepal Army by President Ramchandra Paudel in Kathmandu.
The tradition of conferring honorary ranks to each other's army chiefs by India and Nepal started in 1950.
Both nations discussed strengthening bilateral military ties and mutual cooperation during the visit.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships: Ayush Shetty Stuns World No.1 Shi Yu Qi
bullets: Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty defeated world number one and defending champion Shi Yu Qi of China at the BWF Badminton World Championships in New Delhi.
Top Indian players like PV Sindhu and the women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand also advanced to the second round.
The tournament is being hosted in New Delhi, India.

national_news.title: Uttarakhand CM Inaugurates Asian Open Short Track Speed Skating Trophy 2026
bullets: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami inaugurated the Asian Open Short Track Speed Skating Trophy 2026 in Dehradun.
A total of 272 players from 14 Asian countries, including 130 Indian players, are participating in the event.
The state government plans to establish 23 sports academies across eight major cities under the Sports Legacy Plan and build the state's first sports university in Haldwani.

national_news.title: India and Thailand commence 15th edition of joint military exercise MAITREE-XV
bullets: The 15th edition of India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is held from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.
Both Indian Army and Royal Thai Army contingents comprise 85 personnel each, with the Indian side represented primarily by troops from the 9 Gorkha Rifles.
Instituted in 2006, the exercise focuses on counter-insurgency and counter-terrorist operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.

national_news.title: Department of School Education & Literacy releases UDISE+ Report 2025–26
bullets: The UDISE+ Report 2025–26 covers 14.67 lakh schools, 1.03 crore teachers, and 24.72 crore students across India.
The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) stands at a favorable 24:1, comfortably within the NEP 2020-recommended benchmark of 30:1.
The Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at the Secondary stage improved to 71.7%, while the Middle stage GER remained high at 89.6%.

national_news.title: Ministry of Defence signs Rs 1,943 crore contract to lease two MQ-9B Sea Guardian drones
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) for leasing two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) RPAS for the Indian Navy.
The deal is valued at approximately Rs 1,943 crore and has a lease period of 30 months.
The drones are equipped with advanced sensors and payloads to significantly enhance the Indian Navy's Maritime Domain Awareness and persistent surveillance in the Indian Ocean Region.

national_news.title: Security agencies bust ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti Network in multi-state crackdown
bullets: Indian security agencies detained 253 people across 14 states in a massive coordinated crackdown against the Pakistan-based, ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN).
Over 80 FIRs and 200+ arrests have been recorded under stringent laws including UAPA, BNS, the Arms Act, and Explosive Substances Act.
Operations led to the recovery of IEDs, grenades with Pakistan Ordnance Factory markings, pistols, and espionage equipment ahead of Independence Day.

national_news.title: Department of Financial Services hosts PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 to deliberate on strategic priorities for Public Sector Banks and Financial Institutions.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that a high-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat will be established soon.
Day 1 deliberations focused on four key themes: Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, Supporting the Investment Cycle, and Global Capability Centres (GCCs).

national_news.title: India Leads Global Areca Nut Production
bullets: India is the world's largest producer of areca nut (betel nut/supari), accounting for about 63% of total global production in 2025-26 according to DASD data.
The total area under arecanut cultivation increased to 11.06 lakh hectares in 2025-26, with total production estimated at 15.29 lakh tonnes.
Karnataka is the largest producing state in India, yielding about 10 lakh tonnes, followed by Kerala, Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, West Bengal, and Tamil Nadu.

national_news.title: Centre Approves Qadian-Beas Railway Line Project in Punjab
bullets: The Centre approved a detailed estimate of ₹1,419.05 crore for the new 39.68 km Qadian-Beas broad-gauge railway line in Punjab's Majha region.

The project infrastructure includes two crossing stations (Ghuman and Butala), 11 major bridges, 121 minor bridges, 54 Road Under Bridges (RUBs), and the deployment of India's indigenous train collision avoidance system, Kavach.
Originally approved during 1928-29, the project was revived under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme to serve as an alternative strategic corridor for the Amritsar-Pathankot section.

national_news.title: India-EU Trade Pact and CBAM Compliance Challenges
bullets: The EU and India concluded Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations in January 2026, coinciding with the entry of the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) into its definitive financial phase.
Differences in how India and the EU measure and recognize carbon costs risk imposing a double compliance burden on Indian exporters.
Harmonization of domestic emissions regulations with the EU's CBAM framework is critical to prevent the erosion of potential gains from the India-EU trade liberalisation.

bihar_news.title: Hoymiles Deploys 350 kW String Inverters in Gaya, Bihar Under PM-KUSUM
bullets: Global energy solutions company Hoymiles commissioned a 7.7 MW solar power project in Gaya, Bihar, marking its first project under the PM-KUSUM initiative.
The project utilizes 20 units of HINV350HX-G2 string inverters, each with a rated capacity of 350 kW and a maximum efficiency of 99.05%.
The project was executed by Naw Dharam Energy as the EPC partner, with Sun Solista serving as the distribution partner.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Activities After October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that mining activities in the state are expected to resume after October 15, 2026.
The tender process for 28 mining blocks is underway, with over 30 blocks expected to be allotted before the end of September.
The state government aims to attract Rs 5 lakh crore in investments by November and create 1 crore jobs by 2030.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines Organises Roadshow for 8th Tranche of Critical Mineral Blocks in Patna
bullets: The Ministry of Mines organized a roadshow in Patna for the 8th Tranche of Auction of Critical and Strategic Mineral Blocks alongside a workshop on the National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT).
The event was chaired by Satish Chandra Dubey, Union Minister of State for Coal and Mines, in the presence of Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary and State Mines Minister Pramod Kumar.
The 8th tranche includes 20 mineral blocks comprising 3 Mining Leases and 17 Composite Licences for minerals like Graphite, Rare Earth Elements, Vanadium, and Potash.

bihar_news.title: Administrative Structure and District Overview of Bihar
bullets: Bihar comprises 38 districts administered under 9 administrative divisions: Patna, Tirhut, Saran, Darbhanga, Kosi, Purnia, Bhagalpur, Munger, and Magadh.
West Champaran is the largest district by area (5,229 sq km), while Sheohar is the smallest.
Patna is the capital and the most populous district, while 7 districts of Bihar share an international border with Nepal.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Sets Rs 5 Lakh Crore Investment Target and Announces Policy Reforms
bullets: Bihar set an ambitious investment target of Rs 5 lakh crore by November to boost industrialization in the state.
New industrial policies and educational initiatives were announced, including a target to provide jobs for 1 crore youths by 2030.
The announcements were part of the state government's strategic roadmap for economic development and employment generation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans New Airports and Helipads to Boost Regional Connectivity and Tourism
bullets: Bihar government has formulated plans to develop new airports and helipads across the state to enhance air connectivity, tourism, and investment.
The initiative involves close coordination with the Union Civil Aviation Ministry and other relevant authorities.
Aimed at driving economic growth and improving regional transport infrastructure in the state.

bihar_news.title: Special Intensive Revision in Bihar Led to Record Voter Turnout in Assembly Polls: CEC
bullets: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar stated that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar contributed to a record-high voter turnout.
The November assembly polls registered a voter turnout of 67.25 per cent, the highest in the state since Independence.
The Election Commission highlighted that around 70 lakh ineligible or duplicate names were removed during the three-month revision exercise.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Construction of 100 Modern Bus Stands
bullets: Bihar announced plans to build over 100 modern, state-of-the-art bus stands to improve road transport connectivity and urban infrastructure.
The announcement was made during the unveiling of a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Jamui district.
The initiative is part of broader efforts to boost industrial development and modernize public utilities across the state.

bihar_news.title: Railway Ministry Approves Sherghati-Kajree Rail Link Connecting Bihar and Jharkhand
bullets: The Railway Ministry issued a sanction memorandum for the 107.89-km broad gauge railway line connecting Sherghati in Bihar’s Gaya district with Kajree in Jharkhand’s Palamu district.
The total estimated cost of the project is ₹2,627.29 crore, executed by the East Central Railway.
The project is expected to reduce travel distance by about 70 km and boost trade, employment, and regional connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Warns Doctors Against Unnecessary Patient Referrals
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary warned government doctors against unnecessary patient referrals during a public event in Jamui.
The state government is equipping district and sub-divisional hospitals to perform 36 types of surgeries locally to reduce patient travel.
Strict departmental action has been announced against doctors who refer patients without justified medical reasons.

bihar_news.title: Key Infrastructure and Governance Updates from Bihar Press Releases
bullets: Road and water infrastructure for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) is targeted for completion before 2027, with water planned to be brought from the Sone river to the Falgu river.
The 'Vidyarthi Sahyog Portal' was announced to eliminate student grievances and bring transparency to the education system.
Plans are underway to construct a World Trade Center in Patna to boost trade, industry, and economic activities.
